home.title: Steam profile design without the hassle
home.lead: Cut backgrounds, pictures and videos for showcases, squeeze GIFs under the Steam limit and see how it all looks on your profile. Everything runs in your browser.

cutter.title: Showcase cutter
cutter.text: Artwork, featured artwork, screenshots and workshop. Works with a picture, a GIF, a video or an animated Steam background.

builder.title: Builder
builder.text: Your own picture for a showcase: background, character, captions and light animation. Comes out as ready Steam parts.

optimizer.title: GIFs under 5 MB
optimizer.text: Every part fits the limit and all parts share the same frames, so the animation stays in sync.

preview.title: Profile preview
preview.text: See the result on your own profile by link or SteamID before uploading anything.

backgrounds.title: Backgrounds and frames
backgrounds.text: Backgrounds, mini profiles, frames and avatars from the Points Shop with search and try-on.

infobox.title: Info box
infobox.text: BBCode, ASCII art and centered text.

helper.title: Upload helper
helper.text: An extension or userscript that fills in the right codes on the Steam upload page for you.

source.title: Source
source.linkPlaceholder: Link to a file or a profile
source.linkHint: Paste a direct link to a picture, GIF or video. With a Steam profile link its background is used, animated ones too.
source.match: Find a background for this picture

empty.title: Drop a file here
empty.text: Or choose one on the left: a picture, a GIF or a video. A Steam background, an artwork or a clip will do.

kind.title: Showcase
kind.workshopNote: Steam crops long workshop parts to a square. For GIFs the hex patch fixes that, PNG and JPG don't have it yet.

frame.title: Position
frame.hint: Drag the frame with the mouse, scroll to zoom, arrow keys move it by a pixel, 10 with Shift. "Like on profile" puts the showcase where it lands when it's the first one.

clip.title: Animation
clip.frames: Frames: {{count}}. Fewer frames means better quality at the same size.
clip.hexHint: Needed for the workshop, otherwise Steam crops the parts to a square. Optional for artwork.

format.title: Format
format.hint: PNG is lossless but heavier. If a file doesn't fit into 5 MB, use JPG.

export.thinning: Didn't fit into 5 MB, dropping some frames…
export.tooBig: Some files are over 5 MB and Steam won't take them. Try JPG or a smaller height.
export.animTooBig: Even with fewer colors and frames it doesn't fit into 5 MB. Make it shorter, lower the frame rate or the height.
export.failed: Couldn't build the files. Try again or use another source.

result.thinned: Some frames were dropped to fit the limit.
result.sync: If the parts play out of sync after uploading, refresh your profile page. Once everything is cached they play together.

upload.title: How to upload to Steam
upload.step2: 2. Pick the file and open the browser console: Ctrl+Shift+J in Chrome, Ctrl+Shift+K in Firefox. In Firefox type allow pasting first.
upload.step3: 3. Paste the code below, press Enter and save. If there are several files, upload them in the numbered order.
upload.note: In the artwork list the picture will look like a thin line, that's expected.
upload.workshopNote: Then add each file to favorites and pick them in the workshop showcase in the same order.
upload.helper: Don't feel like using the console? Install the upload helper.

errors.unsupported_link: Can't read this link. Use a direct link to a file or a Steam profile.
errors.load_failed: Couldn't load the file. If it opens in the browser, download it and choose it from disk.
errors.cannot_decode: The browser couldn't open this video. Try another format or Chrome.
errors.no_background: This profile has no Points Shop background.
errors.steam_unavailable: Steam isn't responding, try again later.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hint: Pulls the name, avatar, frame, level, background and theme. Private profiles only give the name and avatar.
profile.name: Name

background.title: Background
background.fullWidthHint: Steam stretches the background to the window width in this mode, so the cut parts drift. For aligned showcases keep the background at original size.

showcases.title: Showcases
showcases.empty: Nothing here yet. Cut something and press "Show on profile", or add ready files.

builder.title: Builder
builder.lead: Put together your own picture for a showcase: background, character, captions and light animation. Comes out as ready Steam parts.
builder.empty: Load a background on the left or add a picture and text right away.

background.title: Background
background.hint: Drag an empty spot to move the background, scroll over an empty spot to zoom it.

layers.title: Layers
layers.empty: Add a character picture or a caption. A PNG with a transparent background works best.

layer.title: Layer
layer.hint: Drag the layer with the mouse, scroll to resize, arrow keys move it by a pixel, Delete removes it.

projects.title: Project
projects.name: Project name
projects.hint: Everything is saved in this browser automatically. The project file is a copy on your disk: handy if the browser clears its data or you want to continue on another computer.
projects.saveError: Couldn't save, the browser is probably out of space. Download the project file so you don't lose your work.
projects.confirmDelete: Delete project “{{name}}”? This can't be undone.

errors.import: This isn't a project file. Use the zip from the “Download file” button.
errors.open: Couldn't open the project. If the background was a video, this browser may not play it.

cutout.title: Remove background
cutout.empty: The model didn't find anything in the picture. For anime and objects use Quality.
cutout.error: Didn't work. The model is downloaded from Hugging Face, which is sometimes flaky, try again.

note.quality: RMBG-1.4 model by BRIA AI, non-commercial use only. Good with anime characters and objects. Downloaded once, then taken from the browser cache.
note.fast: MODNet is trained on photos of people: it doesn't see anime or objects, use Quality for those. Downloaded once, then taken from the browser cache.

effect.hint: The effect covers the whole showcase. Layers above it in the list are drawn over the particles.

loop.title: Animation loop
loop.videoNote: A video background stays on its first frame on the canvas, in the GIFs it moves.

infobox.title: Info box
infobox.lead: An editor for the custom info box and profile summary. Write BBCode on the left, see how Steam will show it on the right.
infobox.sample:
[h1]Hi![/h1]
I play here and sometimes make profile designs.

[b]Favorites:[/b]
[list]
[*]indie games
[*]roguelikes
[*]co-op in the evenings
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Add me if you want to play together.
infobox.heightNote: Steam shows the showcase up to 600 px tall, after that it scrolls.
infobox.centerHint: Centering is approximate: Steam uses its own font, a line may shift by a character or two.

braille.title: Picture to symbols
braille.text: Turns a picture into a pattern of braille symbols. They all have the same width, so the drawing doesn't fall apart like regular ASCII art.
braille.invertHint: Dots are light on the dark Steam background, so this usually looks better.

nick.title: Name styles
nick.text: Unicode letters that look like a different font. Latin letters and digits only, Cyrillic doesn't have them.
nick.invisibleHint: The U+3164 filler, your name looks empty.

guide.title: How to upload a design to Steam
guide.lead: Steam doesn't let you upload long pictures directly, so on the upload page you paste a short code into the browser console. Sounds scary, takes a minute.

helper.title: Upload helper
helper.text: A panel shows up on the Steam upload page: pick the showcase, then the file, and the codes are filled in for you. No more console. There are two ways to install it, both work the same.

extension.title: Extension
steps: Download the archive and unzip it into a folder you won't delete.
Open the extensions page: chrome://extensions, or browser://extensions in Yandex Browser.
Turn on developer mode and press "Load unpacked".
Pick the folder with manifest.json in it.
extension.note: It's not from a store, so it goes in through developer mode and the browser may remind you about it now and then. It doesn't update itself: for a new version download the archive again and replace the files in the folder.

userscript.title: Userscript
userscript.for: Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey, works in Firefox too
steps: Install the Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey extension.
Press "Install script" and confirm.
userscript.note: Handy if you already have a script manager.

usage: Open the artwork upload page, the panel appears in the bottom right corner.
Pick the showcase, then the file. For workshop and guides the GIF gets the hex patch automatically.
Tick the box saying it's your work and save.
helper.note: The helper only runs on the artwork upload page and doesn't send anything anywhere. It never ticks the "it's my work" box, that one is on you.

before.title: Before you start
items: Showcases unlock at Steam level 10, every 10 levels after that give one more.
Your profile and artwork must be public, otherwise visitors won't see the showcase.
The profile background must be at original size, not full screen, otherwise the parts won't line up.
Every file must be under 5 MB.

guide.console: Open the console with Ctrl+Shift+J in Chrome and Edge, Ctrl+Shift+K in Firefox. Firefox will ask you to type allow pasting first, that's normal.

artwork.title: Artwork and featured artwork
steps: Open the artwork upload page.
Pick the file, type any title and tick the box saying it's your work.
Open the console, paste the code and press Enter.
Press "Save and continue". If there are two parts, repeat for the second one.
In profile editing add the showcase and pick the pictures: the wide one in the main slot, the narrow one on the right.
artwork.note: In the artwork list the picture looks like a thin line. That's the code at work, it's expected.

screenshot.title: Screenshots
steps: Open the same upload page.
Pick the file, type a title and tick that it's your work.
Paste the screenshot code into the console, press Enter, then save.
In profile editing pick the uploaded pictures in the screenshot showcase.
screenshot.note: The code differs from the artwork one by a bit at the end, don't mix them up.

workshop.title: Workshop
steps: Open the same upload page.
Pick the file, open the console, paste the code and press Enter.
Save. Do this for all five parts in order.
Open each uploaded item and add it to favorites.
Pick them in the workshop showcase in the same order.
workshop.note: Long parts need the hex patch. The cutter applies it for you, and there's a tool below for ready GIFs.

hex.title: Hex patch for ready GIFs
hex.text: Changes the last byte of a GIF, so Steam shows it without cropping and keeps transparency. Files never leave your browser.

missing.title: Showcase didn't show up?
items: Check your level, showcases unlock at 10.
The artwork must be visible to everyone, not only friends.
If the parts are misplaced, make sure the background isn't full screen. If you cut with "Like on profile", the showcase has to be the first one.
If GIFs play out of sync, refresh the page a couple of times. Until the files are cached they start at different moments.

check.noBackground: This profile has no Points Shop background.
check.canvasOk: Background was drawn to canvas, CORS is fine.
check.canvasFail: Could not read the background from canvas.
